d: One day after US President Donald Trump suffered a wipeout at the 2026 Midterm elections, China announced that it had formally inducted its most powerful Intercontinental Ballistic Missile, the DF-61 that can strike anywhere in the United States. The DF-61 was first unveiled in 2025 during a military parade and has now been officially inducted with the People's Liberation Army Rocket Force. According to Chinese Media reports, the DF-61 missile will be deployed in the Inner Mongolia province and in the Shanxi province.
